description: Test data of case DM-001 (common data objects, design 5.1 table 6). Every device value is a test value chosen for the checks, not a selected device. Components and connections are listed in a scrambled order on purpose, so that the node, path and exposed-node orders of the assembled objects are checked against the design order and not against the input order. The battery numbers C_B = 1000 J/K, T_B = 303 K, T_R = 300 K, R_BR = 0.5 K/W and Q_B = 10 W are the battery example of design 4.3.

coupled_power_event.note: the Power stand-in result is replaced, through PowerCoupling(solve=...), by a confirmed supply_shortfall decision while the load is connected and t >= 150 s; the runner locates the boundary within event_time_tol_s, discards the sub-integrations that meet the event and applies supply_loss
